Happiny

Normal

Sinnoh · Generation 4 · Baby Pokémon

Happiny is a Normal-type Playhouse Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4), and is classed as a Baby Pokémon. It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 24.4 kg. It evolves into Chansey. Its highest base stat is HP (100), with a base stat total of 220.
